releases.notes:
# EN:
# Zombie Infection 0.5.0-dev.2

A small gameplay-polish update for the upcoming 0.5 release.

> **Development Build**
>
> This version is still in active development.
> The current UI is temporary and will be redesigned in a future update.

## Added

- Health bars for:
  - Common Infected
  - Runner
  - Bloater
  - Spitter
- Health bars now show:
  - localized infected name
  - current HP
  - maximum HP
  - short damage feedback
- Health bars only appear when the infected is nearby, being looked at, or was recently damaged.
- Health bars are hidden through walls and while using F1.
- New short tooltips for medical items, biological materials and treatments.
- Extraction Kit feedback now appears in the action bar.
- Extraction Kit tooltip now shows useful extraction and durability information.
- Added a small **BETA / DEVELOPMENT** indicator to the current menu.

## Loot Changes

Special Infected no longer drop their unique materials constantly.

### Common Infected
- 0–1 Rotten Flesh

### Runner
- Adrenal Gland: **25%**
- Looting can slightly increase the chance.

### Bloater
- Toxin Sac: **18%**
- Looting can slightly increase the chance.

### Spitter
- Reactive Enzyme: **20%**
- Looting can slightly increase the chance.

Normal loot and the **Extraction Kit** remain separate systems.

Unwanted vanilla zombie equipment and special vanilla drops were removed from custom infected.

## Balance

Base health remains unchanged:

- Common Infected — **20 HP**
- Runner — **16 HP**
- Bloater — **40 HP**
- Spitter — **20 HP**

No major AI or movement-speed rebalance was made in this update.

## Localization

Updated translations for:

- English
- Spanish
- Spanish (Mexico)

## Notes

This is still a development build.

Some gameplay elements, especially health-bar appearance, loot balance and general combat feel, may continue to change before the final 0.5 release.

The full UI redesign is planned for a later build.

releases.notes:
## Cambios de la versión 0.4.0

- Monitor de infección oscuro y adaptable, separado del inventario vanilla y compatible con interfaces de otros mods.
- Menú principal tematizado como red de cuarentena, conservando los botones y acciones de Minecraft y Mod Menu.
- Regreso correcto al inventario de supervivencia o creativo después de cerrar el monitor.
- Eliminación del listener de ratón duplicado del botón de acceso médico.
- Límite local progresivo para impedir acumulaciones masivas de infectados especiales.
- Grupos naturales más pequeños y composición inicial con menos predominio de Runners.
- Clínicas y farmacias abandonadas considerablemente más fáciles de encontrar durante exploración normal.
- Estado Outbreak ampliado con información sobre el protocolo de contención local.
- Recursos y traducciones revisados en inglés, español y español de México.

readmeSummary: Zombie Infection transforma el Overworld en un brote zombi progresivo.
